## Summary

Describe the observable change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Ruff and mypy pass
- [ ] Bandit and pip-audit pass
- [ ] Tests pass with coverage at least 93%
- [ ] Browser E2E passes when HTTP or GUI behavior changes
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when needed

## Security

- [ ] No token, credential, private path, or sensitive payload is logged or committed
- [ ] HTTP input, output, headers, and permissions were reviewed when applicable
- [ ] New or changed dependencies were audited
